prompt: The city wants to raise its overall recycling rate. Which takeaway matters most?

options.feedback: True, but it doesn't answer the client's question.

options.text: East recycles far less than the other neighborhoods
options.feedback: Right. East is at 15%; North, South and West are at 42–45%.

options.text: All neighborhoods recycle at similar rates
options.feedback: That misreads the chart: East recycles 15%; the others 42–45%.

options.text: East lacks recycling bins, which is why its rate is so low
options.feedback: The chart doesn't show this. It may be true, but there is no data here to support it.

explanation: East recycles far less than the other neighborhoods. East is at 15%; North, South and West are at 42–45%.

extras.proof: East is at 15%; North, South and West are at 42–45%.
